To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) perceived trajectories of life satisfaction differ across the life span; (2) perceived changes in life satisfaction across the life span are linked to adaptive functioning and health; (3) perceived changes in subjective well-being are not random but are associated with sociodemographic factors; and (4) perceived trajectories of subjective well-being are linked to personality traits and social support.
(1) perceived trajectories of life satisfaction are not uniform across the life span and (2) these trajectories are associated with changes in adaptive functioning across adulthood.
